lines.cap: In the Yakuza, if you screw up badly, you say sorry with your pinky. And we mean literally.
lines.say: In the Yakuza, if you screw up badly, you say sorry with your pinky. And we mean literally.

lines.cap: The Yakuza. Japan's organised crime families. At their peak in the 1960s, they had over a hundred and eighty thousand members.
lines.say: The Yakuza. Japan's organised crime families. At their peak in the 1960s, they had over a hundred and eighty thousand members.

lines.cap: Unlike most gangs, they were almost public. Offices with their logo on the door. Business cards. Even magazines for members.
lines.say: Unlike most gangs, they were almost public. Offices with their logo on the door. Business cards. Even magazines for members.

lines.cap: Break the rules, and you perform yubitsume. You cut off the top of your own little finger, wrap it in cloth, and give it to your boss.
lines.say: Break the rules, and you perform yubitsume. You cut off the top of your own little finger, wrap it in cloth, and give it to your boss.

lines.cap: Old story: with a weaker grip, a swordsman had to depend more on his boss to protect him.
lines.say: Old story: with a weaker grip, a swordsman had to depend more on his boss to protect him.

lines.cap: Full body tattoos too. Hand-poked, taking years. Which is why many Japanese gyms and hot springs still ban tattoos.
lines.say: Full body tattoos too. Hand-poked, taking years. Which is why many Japanese gyms and hot springs still ban tattoos.

lines.cap: Then, the twist. After the 2011 earthquake and tsunami, Yakuza groups were reported sending trucks of food and supplies to victims, within hours.
lines.say: Then, the twist. After the 2011 earthquake and tsunami, Yakuza groups were reported sending trucks of food and supplies to victims, within hours.
